deprecations.name: accessibleLabel

replacement.name: aria-label
replacement.usage: Use element.ariaLabel or setAttribute('aria-label', label); host attribute presence takes precedence over the compatibility fallback.

deprecations.rationale: The native host accessible-name API replaces this fallback property. The earlier accessible-label attribute deprecation has its own published release window; the programmatic property remains supported throughout its later window.

deprecations.name: arrow

replacement.name: withoutArrow
replacement.usage: Set withoutArrow to the inverse of arrow; use without-arrow to preserve the former arrow-free default.

deprecations.rationale: The shared negative arrow switch resolves conflicting arrow inputs and defaults to false. The retained positive alias has the inverse value and remains functional throughout the compatibility window.
